numerics_sample.rule: every len/n-th item of each profile, in the mixture's own order

plan._float32_gemm_is: the float32 head product [rows, H] x [H, V]: under half / a quarter of the L40S's 91.6 TFLOPS FP32
plan._float64_is: the oracle's float64 elementwise work: the L40S runs FP64 at 1/64 of FP32 (1.43 TFLOPS peak)
plan._per_element_is: one exponential (~20-25 DP ops) plus the log-softmax, the KL term and three masked sums per candidate; the teacher's pass is shared by every candidate
plan._forward_is: Stage V's measured DEPTH forward per item at bsz=3, scaled for a bsz=1 forward of one item
plan._python_is: per sampled item: sketches, quantiles, transfers and bookkeeping outside the kernels -- unmeasured, allowed for explicitly
plan._analysis_is: Stage V's allowance for the CPU-side validity report per profile

deadline_protection.step_gate: a step starts only when the driver's deadline covers its whole registered bound (step_bounds_s)
deadline_protection.inside_steps: W3 checks the deadline before every sampled item and every contribution item, W6 before every evaluation; DEPTH checks it per candidate
deadline_protection.on_failure: a failed or deadline-stopped step keeps what it measured beside its traceback; adoption.json is flushed after every step and written on every exit path; the launcher fetches it before teardown

arithmetic.what: one set of inputs, two computations: the float32 union KL against a float64 oracle on the SAME float32-head teacher distribution and the same candidate logits (per position |d| <= abs + rel x KL64); the float64 bounds; retrieval against the full head's log-softmax; the K+1 confidence against float64 on the same sketch; the c x KL item mean; the raw-KL control inside ONE version-3 evaluation
arithmetic.teacher_distribution: the float32 head distribution the root store defines -- never the native bf16 logits

checks: each union store's identity equals its declaration, including the executed build
the full-scope FFN arm is weighted by this session's union store and divides by the weight sum; the narrow arm is unweighted
DEPTH reads the ROOT union store with retrieval; every decision score equals the recorded objective
every version-3 evaluation reads its union store and forwards the teacher zero times

row_equivalence.what: W4 vs W5 (DEPTH) and W6 (state) at the formal bsz=3

not_gated.rule: recorded as measured -- including a narrow K+1 confidence range, an unchanged ranking or a small union effect -- and never a reason to change K, the mapping, the tail formula, the support or a tolerance after the fact

acceptance.raw_kl_control_rule: state.objective.raw_kl.* against state.teacher_kl.* of the SAME version-3 evaluation; a KL on another support (the historical reference_topk_tail_v1 diagnostic) is REFUSED as a control; require_objective_support is never bypassed to build one
acceptance.verdicts: arithmetic and integrity PASS -> validation PASS; scored_rows_equivalence PASS -> D2 may run scored_v1, otherwise all_v1
acceptance.adoption: d2v3_gpu_validation.adopt: COMPLETE, identities equal to the committed records, verdicts recomputed from the measurements equal to the recorded ones, the executed commit the granted one, validation PASS

scientific_decision_rubric.status: a RECOMMENDATION rubric for the maintainer's decision on preregistration v3; never a code gate, never a reason to change K, the mapping, the tail formula or the support
scientific_decision_rubric.reference_point: version 2 on the same teacher and mixtures (Stage V): c_T IQR 0.042-0.055, ESS fraction >= 0.994, weighted vs unweighted root-KL DEPTH ranking rho 0.999 with the same choice, weighted objective 96-97% of the raw KL

signals.weighting: W1: the K+1 c_T IQR and ESS fraction over scored positions per profile; W3: the weighted share against the unweighted share by span, domain and critical token; W4: weighted vs unweighted union-KL ranking (rho, same choice, top-3)
signals.support: W3: union / full and teacher-Top-K / full KL ratios, union size and overlap; W4: union vs teacher-Top-K ranking (rho, same choice)
signals.reference: W4: parent vs root rankings (version 2 already showed rho 0.816 and a different choice)

scientific_decision_rubric.GO: validation PASS, and at least one of: the weighted and unweighted union-KL DEPTH choices differ; their ranking rho < 0.95; the K+1 c_T IQR at least twice version 2's (>= 0.11) on both profiles. Then version 3 tests more than the root reference, and the full search is recommended for the maintainer's approval
scientific_decision_rubric.HOLD: validation PASS but the weighting is as inert as version 2's: IQR <= 0.06 on both profiles, ESS fraction >= 0.99, weighted vs unweighted rho >= 0.99 with the same choice. Then a version-3 search would mainly test the root reference and the union support; the recommendation is an explicit maintainer decision between running it with that claim boundary and stopping D2 -- NOT a further redefinition of the confidence
scientific_decision_rubric.between: any other PASS: reported as measured with both readings; the maintainer decides
scientific_decision_rubric.NO-GO: validation FAIL on arithmetic or integrity that a root-caused engineering repair cannot clear: version 3 is not measurable as defined
never: tuning K, the mapping, a temperature, a mask or the tail formula on these numbers
citing the stand-in checkpoint's confidence range as the teacher's

hardware._peak_is: Stage V's measured V4 peak plus every union store and one block's transients; the float64 oracle holds at most ~19 [64, V] float64 blocks (~1.5 GB)

the union-vs-full ratios, union sizes and tails on real teacher logits; weighted-vs-unweighted rankings
the float32-head vs native-bf16 protocol difference
does_not: run a D2 search, recovery training or a behavioural probe
touch D1, D3 or their records
change K, the mapping, the tail formula or a tolerance on its results
